name: Siendo Marta Diaz
overview: A few days before her 25th birthday, Marta Díaz reveals who she was, is, and will be. With the support of family and friends, and many unpublished confessions, the content creator confronts the traumas, challenges, and decisions that will shape her new self. Marta will discover that growing older isn't the end of the world... but the beginning of her own life.
